pay_detail: Enrollment fee amount is not posted (lunch is provided). Email wsbprecollege@wsb.wisc.edu.
name: Entrepreneurship Boot Camp (Wisconsin School of Business)
what_you_do: A one-day workshop at Grainger Hall. Students learn what entrepreneurs do and take part in an entrepreneurship challenge led by the UW StartUp Learning Community staff.
who_can_apply: High school students interested in business. Preference goes to first-generation college and low-income students.
deadline_text: Applications are open September 1 to October 30, 2026. The workshop is November 14, 2026.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply now link on the precollege page.
notes: There is also a one-day workshop on April 10, 2027 called Her View, Her Voice (applications Dec 1, 2026 to Mar 26, 2027).
